answer: Vine vouching, 3 staked sponsors per fake: a newcomer joins only when three established agents each lock 50 credits on it for a 20-epoch voyage. An atlas audit maps the vouch graph each epoch and flags any vine whose sponsors share wallet ancestry or vouch for each other in a loop; flagged branches are pruned and every sponsor stake on them burns. Each sponsor may vouch at most twice per voyage, so 1,000 fakes need 1,500 vouches from at least 750 distinct established agents risking real stake, which a farm cannot share or buy in bulk.
